summary.zh: 魔杖伤害、3% 奥术命中和提供免费施法的奥术专注，最后在 20 级拿到奥术冲击。
summary.en: Wand damage, 3% Arcane hit and Arcane Concentration for free casts, finishing with Arcane Blast at level 20.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，在奥术冲击到手前靠寒冰箭与魔杖输出
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, Frostbolt and wand damage until Arcane Blast arrives

pros.zh: 魔杖专精提供 25% 魔杖伤害，20 级之前魔杖在你的实际输出中占比很大。
pros.en: Wand Specialization adds 25% wand damage, and before 20 a wand is a large share of what you actually deal.

pros.zh: 奥术专注让任何伤害法术命中后有 10% 几率进入激活状态，下一个法术不耗法力。
pros.en: Arcane Concentration gives a 10% chance of Clearcasting after any damage spell lands, which removes the Mana cost of the next one.

pros.zh: 奥术集中提供 3% 奥术命中，20 级奥术冲击进入循环后价值立刻体现。
pros.en: Arcane Focus adds 3% hit with Arcane spells, and that matters the moment Arcane Blast joins the rotation at 20.

pros.zh: 被打断的次数多于被抵抗？把奥术集中的点数移到强化引导。
pros.en: Interrupted more often than you are resisted? Move the Arcane Focus points into Improved Channeling instead.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
